results.text: "Falling behind" could mean the most disputes at SLA risk or the most disputed value at risk. Here both measures point the same way: queue_disputes_escalated leads with **13** at-risk disputes and **$7,197.75** at risk. Tell me if you meant a different measure, such as the oldest open dispute.

sql.command: SELECT queue_id, SUM(sla_risk_count) AS sla_risk_count, SUM(sla_risk_amount_total) AS sla_risk_amount_total FROM aa_dispute_sla_risk GROUP BY queue_id
